username.title: Cloud username / Local gateway
username.description: Cloud: Somfy account username. Local API: gateway IPv4 address or PIN (XXXX-XXXX-XXXX), without a URL or port.

password.title: Cloud password / Local API token
password.description: Cloud: Somfy account password. Local API: Developer Mode bearer token, not the Somfy account password.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed.

movementDuration.title: Movement Duration
movementDuration.description: Set the duration in seconds of the full movement for each device. Enter in the first field the name of the device and in the second field the duration in seconds.

useClosure.title: Use Closure (EXPERIMENTAL)
useClosure.description: Expose covers using the Matter 1.5 Closure device type instead of WindowCovering, to ease integration testing with controllers that support the newer cluster (SmartThings).

closureOptions.title: Closure Options (EXPERIMENTAL)
closureOptions.description: Opt in per device to the Closure Calibration, Ventilation and Pedestrian optional features. Enter in the first field the name of the device and in the following fields true or false. Only applies when useClosure is enabled.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable the debug for the plugin (development only)

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)
